<thought>To find a Diels‑Alder retro‑template, I will search the template catalog specifying a bond‑formation pattern typical for a [4+2] cycloaddition: two new C‑C single bonds that create a six‑membered ring. The database uses the notation “6-6” for bonds formed between two atoms in a six‑membered ring. Providing this as a criterion should return templates that involve the formation of a six‑membered ring, among which the Diels‑Alder retro‑template will appear. I will request a modest number of results and then select the one whose mapped reaction SMILES shows the characteristic cycloaddition pattern.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
